title: Exact-Q Finite-Setting Steering Gap Laws, Rational Polytope Certificates, and Machine-Checked Two-Copy Superactivation of PVM-Critical Two-Qubit States
abstract: Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) steering of two-qubit states exhibits sharp critical behavior at the projective-measurement (PVM) unsteerability boundary v_c = 1/2 of the Werner family rho_v = v|Psi^-><Psi^-| + (1-v)I/4. Very recently, Zhang and Chen (arXiv:2611.09321, November 2026) proved that every PVM-critical entangled two-qubit state is superactivated by two copies with separable conditional states on Bob's side, while every fixed finite bound m on the number of measurement settings leaves an unsteerable neighborhood around criticality. Here we turn both phenomena into exact, closed-form rational theorems over Q, backed by a zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and a pure-stdlib zero-floating-point-trust certificate verifier (EPR-STEER-CERT-1.0). First, by combining exact great-circle cell counting (R(m) <= m(m-1) + 2), a spherical-cap centroid rearrangement inequality (||m_r||_2 <= alpha_r(1-alpha_r)), and Cauchy-Schwarz, we prove the universal non-asymptotic finite-setting unsteerability law v_m^* >= 1/2 + 1/(2(m^2 - m + 1)) valid for every m >= 1 and every choice of m projective measurements on S^2, matching the exact v_1^* = 1 at m=1, coming within 1.0% of optimal at m=3 (4/7 vs. 1/sqrt(3)), and establishing the quantitative Omega(m^-2) gap law with zero hidden constants. Second, via squared-rational primal-dual steering polytope certificates across m in {2,3,4,6,7,12,15}, we prove that the rational cuboctahedron (m=6, exact threshold v_6^cub = sqrt(5/18) ~= 0.5270, bracketed over Q by a 24-state LHS model at v=21/40=0.525 and a witness at v=53/100=0.530) strictly outperforms the Platonic icosahedron (exact threshold v_6^ico = (1+sqrt(5))/6 ~= 0.5393, (v_6^ico)^2 = (3+sqrt(5))/18) in exact 6-setting steering threshold. Third, for two copies rho_v^{otimes 2} under partially entangled Bell measurements |psi_j(t)>, we derive exact closed-form partial-transpose eigenvalues lambda_min^PT = (1 - v^2(1+2s))/4 (proving strict conditional separability lambda_min^PT >= 1/16 > 0 at v=1/2 for all s in [0,1]), and construct an unconditional, zero-float exact-Q proof of two-copy superactivation of rho_{1/2}^{otimes 2} (extending strictly below criticality to v = 49999/100000 < 1/2) via a Bell sign-parity identity, a degree-5 sum-of-squares polynomial factorization, and the exact spherical moment E_{S^2}[x^2 y^2 z^2] = 1/105. All 18 foundational theorems are machine-checked in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), validated against 100,000-sample Haar SO(3)xSO(3) Monte Carlo (z = 0.96) and 40 matrix PPT checks (error 1.11e-16), and operationalized in 14 exact-Q certificates rejecting 46/46 live adversarial attacks.
